scripts.check-budget: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const p="./dist/assets";const f=fs.readdirSync(p);const b={index:100*1024,"react-vendor":250*1024,motion:150*1024,markdown:180*1024,GraphPanel:200*1024};let err=false;for(const[k,m]of Object.entries(b)){const t=f.find(x=>x.startsWith(k)&&x.endsWith(".js"));if(!t)continue;const s=fs.statSync(`${p}/${t}`).size;const kb=(s/1024).toFixed(2);console.log(`[Budget] ${t}: ${kb} kB (max: ${(m/1024).toFixed(2)} kB)`);if(s>m){console.error(`❌ [RULE-2.7] ${t} exceeded budget!`);err=true;}}if(err)process.exit(1);'
